short_description: French industrial software company founded in 1981 as a spin-off of the Dassault group and headquartered in Vélizy-Villacoublay near Paris, which develops 3D design, simulation, manufacturing and product-lifecycle software around its 3DEXPERIENCE platform (brands include CATIA, SOLIDWORKS, SIMULIA, DELMIA, ENOVIA, BIOVIA and MEDIDATA). Listed on Euronext Paris (DSY) and a CAC 40 component, it reports more than 390,000 customers and about 25,000 employees, and runs the 3DEXPERIENCE Lab startup accelerator. Dassault Systèmes has cooperated with Startuprad.io through its startup programme.
